basic_details.job_title: CSIR NIO Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: CSIR National Institute of Oceanography (CSIR NIO) Project Associate-I Notification 2026 has been released on 22 July 2026 on the official website of CSIR National Institute of Oceanography (CSIR NIO). A total of 2 vacancies have been announced through the CSIR NIO Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: MSc Geology/Applied Geology/Earth Sciences with NET/GATE qualifications
qualification.details: MSc Geology/Applied Geology/Earth Sciences with NET/GATE qualifications. In case of non-availability of suitable NET/GATE qualified candidates, non NET/GATE candidates will be considered and the emoluments will be Rs. 25000/- plus HRA as per GoI rules.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 02-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NIO to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I positions is August 2, 2026. Candidates are strongly advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by CSIR NIO?
faq.answer: CSIR National Institute of Oceanography has released a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Associate - I post. This presents a limited but significant opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Project Associate - I position, candidates must possess an MSc degree in Geology, Applied Geology, or Earth Sciences, along with valid NET/GATE qualifications. Non-NET/GATE candidates may be considered under specific conditions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Project Associate - I post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 31,000. For non-NET/GATE qualified candidates, the emoluments will be Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA as per GoI rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website or use the provided link to submit their applications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Project Associate - I are temporary in nature. This means the employment is for a fixed duration as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Where is CSIR National Institute of Oceanography located?
faq.answer: CSIR National Institute of Oceanography is located in Goa. The recruitment is being conducted for positions within this institute.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment drive is RCV/02/2026. This number should be used for reference when inquiring about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any age relaxation benefits provided?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification PDF for any information regarding age relaxation policies.
